meta.title: RetinaX — Decentralized Vision Care Records & AI Diagnostics Protocol on Stellar
meta.description: RetinaX is a patient-controlled, privacy-preserving vision health protocol built on Stellar (Soroban WASM) featuring ZK-privacy proofs, FHIR v4 compliance, and automated AI diagnostic provider rotation.

nav.githubAria: View RetinaX on GitHub (opens in new tab)

hero.title: Decentralized Vision Care Records & Verifiable AI Diagnostics
hero.subtitle: RetinaX replaces fragmented Electronic Medical Record (EMR) siloes with a patient-controlled, privacy-preserving health data infrastructure. Featuring zero-knowledge proofs, FHIR v4 compliance, and automated AI diagnostic oracle rotation on Soroban.
hero.imageAlt: Optometrist using digital eye examination scanner

privacy.title: Patient-Controlled Privacy & Anonymous Verification
privacy.body: RetinaX integrates Groth16 zk-SNARK verifiers on Soroban, allowing patients to prove medical eligibility—such as meeting visual acuity standards for driver licensing—without revealing private prescriptions or personal identity.
privacy.bullet1: Client-Side AES Encryption for all medical payloads prior to IPFS storage.
privacy.bullet2: Instant Granular Revocation: Patient controls access duration for doctors.
privacy.bullet3: GDPR Art. 25 & HIPAA compliant data transit boundary rules.

aiOracle.title: Decentralized AI Oracles with Automated Failover
aiOracle.body: AI computer-vision models evaluate retinal scans for diabetic retinopathy and glaucoma risk. The `ai_integration` Soroban contract monitors provider response latency and automatically rotates execution to fallback oracle nodes if SLA limits fail.
aiOracle.bullet2: Automated Weight Rotation when primary oracle exceeds SLA response thresholds.
aiOracle.bullet3: FHIR v4 LOINC-coded diagnostic report generation.
